scope: FDM printability check for the isolated CM-01 DripTray STL at the reviewed 30 mm R2 geometry (Box 190 × 135 × 30 mm, centred origin).
evidenceBoundary: Captures FDM printability observations (min wall thickness, max overhang angle, max unsupported area) for the isolated DripTray STL at the reviewed 30 mm R2 geometry. It is not a verdict, requirement evaluation, certification, whole-machine claim, or manufacturing approval.
limitations: Thresholds are provisional FDM candidate values sourced from typical desktop-printer guidelines (1.2 mm wall, 45 deg overhang, 600 mm2 unsupported area). They have not been validated against a specific printer or material datasheet.
The STL geometry is the simplified Box approximation of the DripTray, not the full assembly with fillets or mounting features.
This check covers only min wall thickness and max overhang angle / unsupported area; it does not assess bridging, warping, support structures, surface finish, shrinkage, or material properties.
A measurement below the threshold does not constitute manufacturing approval, fabrication release, or certification.
The not_checked items reported by mcp-dfm are preserved in the evidence as contractual labels; absence of a warning is never a guarantee.

provenance.note: Thresholds sourced from typical FDM desktop-printer community guidelines (1.2 mm minimum wall thickness, 45 deg maximum unsupported overhang, 600 mm2 maximum unsupported projected area). These are reviewed candidates; no printer manufacturer has been consulted.
